pre_declared.question: Does a zero-shot time-series foundation model produce a better-calibrated 5-session forward path for a graded pick than a random walk with trailing-volatility quantiles?
pre_declared.primary_metric: mean pinball loss over q in {0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9}, h in 1..5
secondary_report_only: point accuracy (MAE of median log-return) vs naive_flat
MFE-timing hit rate implied by the q90 path
pre_declared.notes: Secondary metrics are REPORT-ONLY and are declared here so they cannot be promoted to the pass bar after the fact. A pass on a secondary metric with a fail on the primary is a FAIL.
